counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span confirms Auer rods or classical myeloid maturation beyond the blast count
No cytogenetic or molecular AML-defining marker is supplied
Metachromatic blasts and spindle-shaped cells may suggest basophil/mast-cell lineage rather than classic AML with maturation
response.rationale: R4 is favored because 26% marrow blasts crosses the acute leukemia threshold and trilineage dysplasia directly explains the cytopenias and dysplastic marrow. R1 is untenable because >20% blasts excludes isolated MDS. R3 and R5 capture the hemophagocytic/ferritin phenotype but do not explain the leukemic blast population; R5 is the best alternative because erythrophagocytosis plus ferritin >40 000 µg/L strongly indicates HLH, but this remains a secondary syndrome in the setting of an acute myeloid neoplasm.

rejected.why: Shows trilineage dysplasia but ignores the 26% blasts, which exceeds the MDS blast threshold and defines acute leukemia.
Relies on histiocytes/erythrophagocytosis/atypical cells and is largely redundant with the stronger HLH evidence; it does not account for the 26% metachromatic blasts.
